title: Sales team roster
statementMd:
List the first and last names of everyone in the Sales department (`department_id = 2`).

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE department_id = 2;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
